        Except.ok

                  phase := before.phase }.chain,
            buffer :=
              { chain := before.chain, buffer := before.buffer, count := before.count, work := before.work,

            count :=

                  phase := before.phase }.count,
            work :=
              { chain := before.chain, buffer := before.buffer, count := before.count, work := before.work,
                  phase := before.phase }.work,
            phase :=
              Sha256.Phase.finishing
                (Sha256.padding
                  { chain := before.chain, buffer := before.buffer, count := before.count, work := before.work,
                    phase := before.phase }) }
      | Sha256.Phase.finishing x =>
        Except.ok
          { chain := before.chain, buffer := before.buffer, count := before.count, work := before.work,
            phase := before.phase }
      | Sha256.Phase.finished =>
